passMeaning: PASS certifies audit coverage, identity, quarantine, blind adjudication and risk detection. It does not approve keys, factuality, rights, publication, runtime conformity or student efficacy.

renderDependencyClosure.limitation: Static local-import closure from root/site layouts and the Matching Features route; runtime-generated or remote copy still requires browser/runtime review.

provenanceSearch.method: Directed exact-title, exact-first-sentence, named-entity and distinctive-fragment public-web search; reviewed results were compared for verbal identity and case identity.

queries.query: "Different approaches to urban farming" "Green Roof Collective" "Lina Torres"

resultsReviewed.title: Urban Agriculture — USDA National Agricultural Library
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Topical institutional overview of rooftop, school, community and controlled-environment agriculture; no named-entity or verbatim passage match.

resultsReviewed.title: Urban Agriculture — US EPA
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Topical public-sector source on vacant land; no exact project, person or passage match.

queries.query: "Different approaches to studying memory" "Helen Ward" "Moreno Lab" "Kenji Sato"

resultsReviewed.title: Active decision-making and route learning — PubMed
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Conceptually related primary research; no match for Helen Ward, the stated pause/prediction protocol or the passage wording.

resultsReviewed.title: The effect of relative confidence and the co-witness memory conformity effect — DOI 10.1002/acp.3320
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Conceptually close to confident social misinformation and therefore a provenance alert, but no nominal or verbatim match to Moreno Lab.

queries.query: "City transport policies with different goals" "Rivergate Bus Priority Plan" "Northbridge Safe Streets Programme"

resultsReviewed.title: Bus Priority Programme — Transport for London
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Topical institutional source on bus priority and kerbside activity; no Rivergate identity or verbatim match.

resultsReviewed.title: Mobility as a Service code of practice — UK Department for Transport
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Topical public-sector source on multimodal integration and digital exclusion; no named programme or passage match.

provenanceSearch.interpretation: Directed and non-exhaustive. No exact match in reviewed results does not prove originality, authorship, clearance or universal absence of a prior source. The search did not cover licensed databases, print-only works, deleted pages, translations, private documents, drafts or extensive paraphrase. Repository history establishes when content entered this repository, not who created it; conceptual similarity in the memory passage requires human source reconstruction, not automatic attribution.

factualResearch.limitation: Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas permiten contrastar agricultura en azoteas, producción controlada, huertos escolares, lotes vacantes y costes técnicos, pero no acreditan las entidades nombradas ni verifican todos los resultados, clientes, acuerdos o relaciones causales del pasaje.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas permiten contrastar decisiones espaciales, misinformation social, ayudas externas, sueño y pruebas con apuntes, pero no acreditan a Helen Ward, Moreno Lab, Kenji Sato, Sleep Recall Study u Open Notes Group ni los protocolos y efectos exactos atribuidos.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas permiten contrastar prioridad de buses, velocidad segura, integración modal, carga de flotas y peatonalización, pero no acreditan los cinco programas nombrados ni sus corredores, cifras, quejas, fases, consultas o resultados exactos.

sourceAvailability.method: Direct HTTPS retrieval with redirect resolution, response-body SHA-256, content type and byte count. Anti-bot 403/405 responses are retained as observed rather than reclassified as successful retrieval.
sourceAvailability.interpretation: Availability, redirect resolution and body identity do not establish authorship, factual verification, license, rights-holder authorization or endorsement. HTTP 403/405 records document direct-client access limits and do not imply that the underlying source content was reviewed through that response.

studentWalkthrough.limitation: Blind content-only cognitive walkthrough; it does not test UI, accessibility, retention, bands or real students.

runtime.limitation: Detection documents the unchanged runtime. Immediate locking, correctness feedback and pre-response traps prevent representing it as Practice or Exam simulation and block content certification.

antiBias.optionPermutationReason: Letters remain bound to feature labels/descriptions. Binding, declared reuse, distribution, sequence, question-position modulo k, length and statement-to-label/description overlap are audited instead.

sampleAdequacy.conclusion: The sample exposes an 11/19 question-position-modulo-k shortcut and visible descriptions, but n=19 is too small to certify balanced content statistically.

applicability.evidence: Seven learner-facing files and the F0.2b.7 route/engine/bank remain hash-pinned. UI/Playwright ➖ means unchanged and not tested for conformity; inherited accessibility observations remain blockers.

processLimitations.firstPassTrace: The persisted hash detects ordinary mutation but is not an external append-only witness; coordinated post-hoc rewriting cannot be ruled out cryptographically.
processLimitations.directSourceReview: Direct-source review is declared by an AI reviewer and checked for exact IDs plus non-empty locators; it is not automatic proof of browsing, a human signature or factual verification.
processLimitations.sourceAvailability: HTTP 200/403/405 and response hashes document retrieval outcomes only; availability or anti-bot denial does not verify claims, authorship or rights.
processLimitations.provenanceSearch: Public-web search is directed and non-exhaustive; no exact match does not prove original authorship or universal absence.
